sentences.text: A single-center retrospective cohort study in China examined 259 consecutive patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage who underwent endovascular embolization, noting that 67 received norepinephrine during their hospital stay.
The primary outcome was all-cause mortality within 28 days, which was 47.8% in the norepinephrine group compared to 15.7% in the group that did not receive the medication.
After adjusting for laboratory values and other relevant factors, the use of norepinephrine was associated with a higher risk of dying within 28 days.
The authors conclude that prospective studies with detailed dose and duration data are needed to confirm these findings.
